name: logikchain-functions
description: Logikchain Firebase Functions 2nd gen. Export names are constitution API spec operationIds.

scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions,storage,pubsub
scripts.serve:functions: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions --project dev
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && firebase deploy --project dev --only functions --non-interactive
scripts.deploy:test: npm run build && firebase deploy --project test --only functions --non-interactive
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && firebase deploy --project prod --only functions --non-interactive
